name: Vodyanitsa
notes: KQM and Game8 agree on HP% on Sands, Goblet and Circlet, 4pc Tenacity of the Millelith first, Hymn of the Maelstrom first, and Skill first. Game8's second set is Song of Days Past; KQM's are a 2pc Tenacity of the Millelith and 2pc Vourukasha's Glow mix, then Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City, Archaic Petra (with a Geo unit), Ocean-Hued Clam and Song of Days Past. Both are kept. Her damage and healing run on Max HP (Skill 3.27% to 5.89% Max HP, Burst 45.7% to 82.2% Max HP, both elemental curve); the Skill is the one she uses every rotation, so it is the damage talent. Game8's goal is HP 65,000 or more. No ER goal is set: KQM says she skips her Burst in most teams, and only builds ER (145-155 in a double Hydro team with Prototype Amber, 100-130 in triple Hydro) when she Bursts every rotation in Hydro-heavy teams. Partners are inferred (KQM: Hydro damage dealers, ATK-scaling teams); the sources give no team list.
